prism-teal.$description: Prism Teal — Teal supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

deep-teal.$description: Deep Teal — Teal supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color; Top-to-bottom gradient from Deep Teal to white — used in the hero background as a subtle vertical wash

carbon-ink.$description: Carbon Ink — Primary headings, nav text, logo mark, heavy body emphasis — near-black with a cool blue undertone that pairs with the teal accent

graphite.$description: Graphite — Body text, button labels, dense content text — deeper than Carbon Ink, reserved for running copy and form values

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary body text, helper copy, muted descriptions, footer meta — pulls text back without losing legibility

steel.$description: Steel — Tertiary text, disabled labels, icon strokes on neutral backgrounds — one step further back than Slate

fog.$description: Fog — Placeholder text, subtle icon fills, decorative dividers — present but recessive

mist.$description: Mist — Hairline borders, card edges, code-block frames, grid lines — the structural glue that separates surfaces without weight

bone.$description: Bone — Subtle surface lift, secondary card backgrounds, alternating section bands — barely visible, used to create quiet layering

paper.$description: Paper — Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

inter.$description: Body, UI, navigation, and code-adjacent text — Inter with character variants enabled gives the system a custom-cut look inside a familiar sans. Weight 500–600 for nav and button labels, 400 for body, 375 sparingly for captions that need a lighter voice.

mona-sans-vf.$description: Display and heading typeface — GitHub's variable Mona Sans brings geometric authority with subtle humanist warmth; the 0.1em letter-spacing at 64px is the brand's signature: headline text reads as engineered precision, not marketing prose. Weight 900 reserved for hero display, 650 for section headings, 700 for sub-headings.

mona-sans-mono-vf.$description: Inline code, terminal snippets, CLI command pills — the monospaced sibling to Mona Sans keeps code blocks visually tied to the display type

font-awesome-7-pro.$description: Font Awesome 7 Pro — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

font-awesome-7-brands.$description: Font Awesome 7 Brands — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
